7.8.4.5 LINTP_E_DROPPED_CONSECUTIVE_FRAMES_DETECTED
[SWS_LinIf_00885] ⌈
Error Name:
LINTP_E_DROPPED_CONSECUTIVE_FRAMES_DETECTED
Short Description:
Missing Consecutive Frame is detected
Long Description:
LinIf (LinTp part) shall report a LINTP_E_DROPPED_
CONSECUTIVE_FRAMES_DETECTED Extended Production Error
to DEM when missing Consecutive Frames are detected.
Fail
Missing Consecutive Frame is detected
Detection Criteria:
Pass
LinTp_Init() function call
Secondary
Parameters:
The condition under which the FAIL and/or PASS detection is
active: None
Time Required:
Not applicable
Monitor Frequency:
on event
⌋
